source_summaries.ncfrp_v51: The National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (NFR-CRS) codebook v5.1 primarily focuses on documenting the circumstances surrounding sudden unexpected infant deaths, including environmental factors, substance exposures, medical conditions, and potential acts of abuse or neglect. It does not provide detailed information on postconceptional age, maternal smoking during pregnancy, preterm birth status, breastfeeding at discharge, specific genetic or neurological assessments, nor variables related to experimental procedures in animal models.
